edits.current: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. Vacation and paid-leave (VAC-LR) days do not reduce the ARL day count (T2R2-038) because they are paid; maternity or paternity leave days (LMA = X) carry no occupational-risk contribution (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6).
edits.proposed: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling. Vacation and paid-leave (VAC-LR) days are reported on their own detail record (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.2 b) with the number of days of the change event in the ARL day count (T2R2-038); the days of all records add up to 30 (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.13). No occupational-risk contribution is due for enjoyed vacation (VAC-LR = X) (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 numeral 1.3; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022); remunerated leave (VAC-LR = L) remains contributory; maternity or paternity leave days (LMA = X) carry no occupational-risk contribution (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6).

edits.current: Maintain a contributory-day counter PER SUBSYSTEM on the 30-day commercial month. Start at 30 (or the proportion from a mid-month hire or to a mid-month leave), then apply the change events: SLN and lawful strike reduce all four; IGE and IRL follow the subsystem-specific rules; vacation and remunerated leave do not reduce them at all because they are paid.
edits.proposed: Maintain a contributory-day counter PER SUBSYSTEM on the 30-day commercial month. Start at 30 (or the proportion from a mid-month hire or to a mid-month leave), then apply the change events: SLN and lawful strike reduce all four; IGE and IRL follow the subsystem-specific rules; vacation and remunerated leave do not reduce the day counters (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.11 to §2.1.2.3.13), although no occupational-risk contribution is due for enjoyed vacation days (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 numeral 1.3; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022).
